Callout.Name: Body in the Desert
Callout.Message: Body found off a dirt road.

Script.Line: I was out looking for arrowheads and I found that instead.
It is off the dirt road about two hundred yards.
I have marked it with my jacket. That is all I did.

Lines.Approach: Somebody has been out here a while. Nobody has touched anything.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
